# TailAdmin Free HTML

Source: https://github.com/TailAdmin/tailadmin-free-tailwind-dashboard-template
Version: 2.4.0
Commit: 1bd2dc42a8467ae0281cf00bd0050da4c9c4be07
License: MIT (see LICENSE).

README and license inspected before adaptation. Layout adapted from src/blank.html and partials/sidebar.html/header.html. Theme colors adapted from src/css/style.css. Only shell, cards and theme tokens retained; demo charts, ecommerce data, Alpine directives, translations and external fonts omitted. Go templates replace upstream includes. Tailwind CLI replaces upstream Webpack because only CSS and local htmx are needed. Attribution retained; no upstream demo bundle is shipped.
